text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her current level, she stood no chance 
against T.M. Opera O, leaving Meisho Doto 
completely exhausted in both body and 
spirit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, they rejoiced, saying "It was a 
wonderful memory," and enjoyed a modest 
picnic time on the lawn of the central 
plaza.
